mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(cnt), 0) from ( select count(distinct u.id) as cnt from t_exam e inner join t_exam_grade eg on e.id = eg.exam_id inner join t_user u on u.grade_id = eg.grade_id inner join t_role r on u.role_id = r.id and r.code = 'student' where e.id = #{id} and (e.target_type is null or e.target_type = 1) and (u.status is null or u.status = 1) union all select count(distinct eu.user_id) as cnt from t_exam e inner join t_exam_user eu on e.id = eu.exam_id where e.id = #{id} and e.target_type = 2 ) t

select * from t_exam where is_deleted = 0 and ( ((target_type is null or target_type = 1) and id in (select exam_id from t_exam_grade where grade_id in (select grade_id from t_user where id = #{userId}))) or (target_type = 2 and id in (select exam_id from t_exam_user where user_id = #{userId})) ) and id not in (select exam_id from t_user_exams_score where user_id = #{userId})
and title like concat('%',#{title},'%')
order by create_time
asc
desc

id not in (select exam_id from t_user_exams_score where user_id = #{userId})

select * from t_exam where is_deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId}
and title like concat('%',#{title},'%')
